name: xml_ns_strip
title: Removes default namespace declarations so an unprefixed name matches

origin.description: Removes default namespace declarations so an unprefixed name matches.
origin.example: x <- read_xml("<foo xmlns=\"http://foo.com\"><baz/><bar xmlns=\"http://bar.com\"><baz/></bar></foo>"); xml_ns_strip(x); paste(capture.output(x), collapse = "\n")

translation.description: Removes default namespace declarations so an unprefixed name matches.
